meaning:
τοι-γαρ-οῦν
an inferential particle, [in LXX: Job.22:10 24:22, Sir.41:16, al. ;]
wherefore then, so therefore: 1Th.4:8, Heb.12:1 (Hat., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.
Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run…
